tutorial.prompt_text:
Welcome to Audio Tetris!

Would you like to play the interactive tutorial?

-> Press Enter to Start Tutorial
   Press Escape to Go to Main Menu
tutorial.prompt_spoken: Welcome to Audio Tetris! Would you like to play the interactive tutorial? Press Enter for Yes, or Escape for No.
tutorial.stage_1_title: Lesson 1 of 8: Lateral Movement & Stereo Panning
tutorial.stage_2_title: Lesson 2 of 8: Elevation, Soft Drop, & Landing Impact
tutorial.stage_4_title: Lesson 4 of 8: The Hold Slot & Piece Swapping
tutorial.stage_6_title: Lesson 6 of 8: The Radar Sweep (Board Topography)
tutorial.stage_7_title: Lesson 7 of 8: Zone Mode (Time Freeze & Combos)
tutorial.stage_8_title: Lesson 8 of 8: Power-Up Items (Magnet, Laser, Nuke)
tutorial.stage_1_spoken: Lesson 1 of 8: Lateral Movement and Stereo Panning. Use the Left and Right arrows or A and D to move your piece across the board. Notice how the sound pans from left to right. Move all the way left to Column 1, then all the way right to Column 10 to continue.
tutorial.stage_2_text:
%{title}

Objective:
Listen to pitch decrease as piece descends from Row 1 toward Row 20.

Soft drops performed: %{drops} / 5

Controls:
- Down Arrow or S: Soft drop (descending pitch)
- Spacebar: Hard drop instantly to Row 20
- Escape: Exit tutorial
tutorial.stage_2_spoken: Lesson 2 of 8: Elevation, Soft Drop, and Landing Impact. As a piece descends from Row 1 toward Row 20, its pitch gets lower. Press Down Arrow or S to soft drop 5 rows, then press Spacebar to hard drop the piece to Row 20 and hear the landing impact.
tutorial.stage_3_spoken: Lesson 3 of 8: Rotations and Piece Inspection. Press V or Semicolon to inspect your piece shape and see which columns it covers. Next, press X or Period to rotate clockwise, and Z or Comma to rotate anticlockwise. Rotate twice, then press Spacebar to drop your piece.
tutorial.stage_3_inspect_spoken: Current piece: T-shape. Columns %{left} through %{right}. Width: %{width}.
tutorial.stage_4_text:
%{title}

Objective:
Practice holding, swapping, and the hold-denied audio cue.

Controls:
- C or Slash: Hold piece / Swap held piece
- Spacebar: Drop piece to advance
- Escape: Exit tutorial
tutorial.stage_4_spoken: Lesson 4 of 8: The Hold Slot and Piece Swapping. Press C or Slash to hold this piece in reserve. When the next piece appears, press C again to swap it back. Try pressing C a second time on the same turn to hear the hold-denied sound, then press Spacebar to drop and advance.
tutorial.stage_4_hold_1: Held Right zig-zag. New piece: Long bar. Press C or Slash again to swap back.
tutorial.stage_4_hold_2: Swapped back! Now press C or Slash once more this turn to hear the hold-denied cue.
tutorial.stage_4_hold_3: Already held piece this turn. Now press Spacebar to drop and advance.
tutorial.stage_5_p1_text:
%{title}

Part 1: Single Line Clear
Row 20 has 9 blocks filled with a gap in Column 5.

Controls:
- Left/Right: Move to Column 5
- Spacebar: Drop and clear row
- Escape: Exit tutorial
tutorial.stage_5_p1_spoken: Lesson 5 of 8: Line Clears. Part 1: Single Line Clear. Row 20 has 9 blocks filled with a single open slot in Column 5. Move your piece into Column 5 and press Spacebar to trigger a Single Clear!
tutorial.stage_5_p2_text:
%{title}

Part 2: 4-Line Tetris Fanfare
Rows 17 through 20 have an open well in Column 10.

Controls:
- Left/Right: Move to Column 10
- Spacebar: Drop for Tetris Fanfare
- Escape: Exit tutorial
tutorial.stage_5_p2_spoken: Part 2: 4-Line Tetris Fanfare. Rows 17 through 20 have an open well in Column 10. Drop your Long Bar down Column 10 and press Spacebar to trigger the 4-line Tetris Fanfare!
tutorial.stage_6_text:
%{title}

Objective:
Listen to the 10-tone stereo sweep across Columns 1 through 10.

Controls:
- E or L: Activate Radar Sweep
- Spacebar / Enter: Continue after scan
- Escape: Exit tutorial
tutorial.stage_6_spoken: Lesson 6 of 8: The Radar Sweep. The board now contains stacks of different heights across Columns 1 through 10. Press E or L to activate the Radar. Listen as it sweeps 10 stereo tones from left to right. Lower tones mean short stacks, while higher tones mean tall stacks. Press E or L to scan, then press Spacebar or Enter to continue.
tutorial.stage_6_scan_complete: Radar sweep complete: highest stack height 8 in Column 9. Press Spacebar or Enter to continue.
tutorial.stage_7_text:
%{title}

Objective:
Activate Zone Mode to freeze gravity and clear rows.

Controls:
- Q or K: Enter Zone Mode
- Spacebar: Drop pieces
- Escape: Exit tutorial
tutorial.stage_7_spoken: Lesson 7 of 8: Zone Mode. Your Zone meter is now 100% charged! Press Q or K to enter Zone Mode. Notice how gravity completely freezes. Clear two rows before the Zone concludes.
tutorial.stage_7_active: Zone Mode Activated! Gravity is frozen. Press Spacebar to drop your piece and clear rows.
tutorial.stage_8_item_0_name: The Magnet (Pulls blocks downward to seal gaps)
tutorial.stage_8_item_1_name: The Laser (Incinerates the tallest column stack)
tutorial.stage_8_item_2_name: The Nuke (Demolishes the bottom 4 rows of the board stack)
tutorial.stage_8_spoken_0: Lesson 8 of 8: Power-Up Items. You acquired The Magnet! Press Left Shift or Right Shift to pull floating blocks downward and seal empty holes.
tutorial.stage_8_spoken_1: Next power-up: The Laser! Press Shift to fire a high-frequency beam that vaporises the tallest column stack.
tutorial.stage_8_spoken_2: Final power-up: The Nuke! Press Shift to detonate a massive blast that incinerates the bottom 4 rows of the board stack.
tutorial.stage_8_step_0_result: Magnet pulled blocks down! Next: The Laser. Press Shift to fire.
tutorial.stage_8_step_1_result: Laser incinerated the tallest column stack! Final item: The Nuke. Press Shift to detonate.
tutorial.stage_9_text:
%{title}

Congratulations! You have completed the Audio Tetris tutorial.

You have mastered:
- Lateral Movement & Stereo Panning (Columns 1 to 10)
- Pitch-Mapped Elevation (Rows 1 to 20)
- Rotations & Piece Inspection
- Hold Queue & Swapping
- Line Clears & 4-Line Tetris
- 10-Tone Radar Sweep
- Zone Mode Time Freeze
- Power-Up Items (Magnet, Laser, Nuke)

-> Press Enter to Go to Main Menu
tutorial.stage_9_spoken: Congratulations! You have completed the Audio Tetris tutorial and mastered all movement, audio cues, radar sweeps, Zone Mode, and power-up items. You can explore individual keys at any time in Keyboard Help Mode by pressing H on the Main Menu. Press Enter to start your arcade journey!

how_to_play.spoken_intro: How to play. Use arrows to read line by line. Press Enter to read all. Press Escape to go back. %{line}
how_to_play.line_0: Welcome to Audio Tetris! Here is everything you need to know to master the game.
how_to_play.line_1: The Objective: Geometric blocks called Tetrominoes fall one at a time from the top of a 10-column grid called the Matrix.
how_to_play.line_2: Moving & Rotating: Move falling pieces left and right, rotate them to fit into open slots, and drop them into place.
how_to_play.line_3: Clearing Lines: When you fill a complete horizontal row of 10 blocks with no gaps, that row clears and disappears.
how_to_play.line_4: Gravity: Any blocks above a cleared line fall down to fill the empty space.
how_to_play.line_5: Scoring & Combos: Clearing 1, 2, 3, or 4 lines at once (a Tetris!) scores big points, increases your combo multiplier, and charges your Zone meter.
how_to_play.line_6: Game Over: If your stack reaches the very top of the board and blocks new pieces from entering, the game ends.
how_to_play.line_7: Audio Orientation (Panning): Audio is in full stereo. Pieces sound in your left ear for left columns, centred for middle columns, and right ear for right columns.
how_to_play.line_8: Audio Orientation (Pitch): Sound pitch indicates vertical height. Higher pitch means the piece is high up; lower pitch means it is near the bottom or landing on the stack.
how_to_play.line_9: Radar Sweep: Activate Radar at any time to hear a 10-tone stereo sweep revealing the current height of every column on the board.
how_to_play.line_10: Hold Slot: Swap your active piece into the Hold slot to save it for a better moment.
how_to_play.line_11: Zone Mode: When your Zone meter is charged, activate Zone to freeze gravity and clear as many lines as possible before time resumes!
how_to_play.line_12: Power-Up Items: Clearing special rows awards items like Magnet, Laser, or Nuke to help you clean up difficult stacks.
how_to_play.line_13: Keyboard Controls: To explore every key and its action interactively, press H from the Main Menu to enter Keyboard Help Mode.

about.spoken_intro: About Audio Tetris. Use arrows to read line by line. Press Enter to read all. Press Escape to go back. %{line}
about.line_1: Created by Gregory Lopez and Google Antigravity.
about.line_2: A fully accessible, screen-reader-first arcade puzzle game built in Rust.
about.line_3: Engineered with zero graphical reliance, high-precision stereo panning, and pitch-mapped elevation.
about.line_4: Features 12 localised languages, 5 save slots, high score tracking, 9-lesson tutorial, Zone Mode, radar sweeps, power-ups, and auto-updater.
about.line_5: Core Libraries: wxDragon (Allen Dang), Rodio (Pierre Krieger & RustAudio), Tolk (Leonard de Ruijter & Davy Kager), and Rusqlite (John Gallagher & SQLite team).
about.line_6: Localisation & Data: rust-i18n (LongAster), sys-locale (1Password), and Serde & Serde JSON (David Tolnay).
about.line_7: Audio & Utilities: Lofty (EpocDotFr), Rand (The Rand Project), Lazy Static (Marvin Löbel), and WinRes (mxre).
about.line_8: Copyright 2026 Gregory Lopez and Google Antigravity. Released under the MIT License.
